title: Allow only a chosen method
summary: Django: Allow only a chosen method. Send a HEAD request and inspect the allowed-method header.
introduction: A view can inspect request.method. A GET request to /check/ is accepted; another method gets 405.
learningObjectives: Allow only a chosen method with Django
Send a HEAD request and inspect the allowed-method header

blocks.text: Install django~=5.2, run django-admin startproject school, then enter school. Replace school/urls.py with each example and run python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000. These view examples need no database tables.

blocks.title: Allow only a chosen method

blocks.text: For GET the check passes and returns Ready. Other methods receive the allowed-method response.
Send a HEAD request and inspect the allowed-method header.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use 405 for an unsupported method, not 404.
